# Tint It Pro

> Tint It Pro is a Calgary, Alberta company specializing in residential and commercial window film, window tinting, glass protection, and TuffSkin® natural stone protection.

## Company

- Official website: https://tintitpro.ca/
- Location served: Calgary, Alberta, Canada, plus Airdrie, Chestermere, Cochrane, and Okotoks
- Phone: +1-403-470-1687
- Consultation booking: https://tintitpro.setmore.com/
- Google Business listing: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Tint%20It%20Pro&query_place_id=ChIJSeCMo-sKnS4RXSZsamLAv1o

## Services

- Residential window tinting and window film for heat control, glare reduction, UV protection, fade protection, privacy, decorative glass, and security
- Commercial window film for offices, storefronts, multi-unit properties, solar control, privacy, security, and anti-graffiti protection
- TuffSkin® natural stone and countertop protection for marble, onyx, travertine, and other stone surfaces

## Pricing guidance

- Online estimator: preliminary estimates based on surface area, film type, quantity, and access requirements
- Professional on-site consultation: $75 CAD plus GST, credited toward the project when the customer proceeds
- Final pricing depends on the selected film, dimensions, quantity, glass or stone type, access, and installation requirements
